text:
alex: Morning — quick async: what I did / blockers / today.

alex: What I did: pushed kernel change to prefer microbatching for short sequences (PR #482). Ran staging perf sweep — p95 down ~7%, p50 improved, p99 slightly noisy.

alex: Blocker: KV cache thrash on mixed workloads. When long-context requests and many short requests interleave, eviction spikes and we lose hot prefixes.

alex: Today: investigating eviction thresholds, adding small hysteresis in slot allocator; plan to roll a canary to staging later.

maria: Nice work. Can you drop the perf graph when you have a sec? Also pinged on the PR for a review. :thumbsup:

maria: Quick note from logs — prefetched KV keys often evicted within ~1s during an 8KB burst pattern.

sam: @alex for the canary please add a runtime flag so we can toggle hysteresis without full deploy. Ops wants kill-switch.
sam: I can run traffic replay against staging after you push.

alex: Will add the flag. Draft config I'm thinking:
```yaml
kv:
  eviction_hysteresis_ms: 200
  min_slots_per_shard: 4
```

jia: Small thought — use a time-decayed frequency score instead of strict slot counts? Might smooth churn on the penultimate shards.
jia: Happy to pair and model the decay parameter.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-2026-03-18-14:00 UTC -> automated smoke after rollout.

alex: Thanks. Sam — can you queue the replay for 14:30 UTC? Maria — starting PR review now.
maria: On it. Quick pass done, left 2 nits inline.
sam: Queued -> job id: replay-7892. Will post results back here.
sam: Initial run: p95 ~6% improvement, p99 unchanged. Snippet:
```text
staging-replay-7892: p50 12ms p95 42ms p99 120ms
baseline: p50 13ms p95 45ms p99 118ms
```

alex: Hmm — p99 a bit noisy but roughly same. I'll bump hysteresis to 300ms and increase min_slots to 6, then re-run.
alex: Any concerns about memory footprint with higher min_slots?
maria: Small memory increase, should be fine for Dedicated pools. Add a metric card for slot usage and alert if it exceeds threshold.
jia: I'll sketch a simulator comparing decay vs hysteresis this afternoon and post numbers.

ops-bot: replay-7892 completed -> results uploaded to /artifacts/replay-7892/results.json

alex: Thanks everyone — will update the PR and ping once canary looks stable. If anyone wants to help with the simulator or review the new flag, please ping me. :raised_hands:
